In figure $ABCDEF$ shown above, which of the following are equal to the vector $\overset{\to }{DF}?$

I. $\overset{\to }{DC}+\overset{\to }{CB}+\overset{\to }{BF}$

II. $\overset{\to }{FB}-\overset{\to }{DB}$

III. $\overset{\to }{DE}+\overset{\to }{EF}$
question.worked_solution:
- For the $1$st expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{DC}+\overset{\to }{CB}+\overset{\to }{BF} & =(\overset{\to }{DC}+\overset{\to }{CB})+\overset{\to }{BF} \\  & =\overset{\to }{DB}+\overset{\to }{BF} \\  & =\overset{\to }{DF}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

- For the $2$nd expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{FB}-\overset{\to }{DB} & =\overset{\to }{FB}+\overset{\to }{BD} \\  & =\overset{\to }{FD} \\  & \ne \overset{\to }{DF}\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

- For the $3$rd expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{DE}+\overset{\to }{EF} & =\overset{\to }{DF}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and III only".
